title: _photo_meta.json
description: Provenance for real photographs. One file per asset folder, keyed by filename, sitting beside the images it describes. Validated by scripts/check_assets.py.

source.description: organisation or repository the file came from

url_or_origin.description: page URL, or the project path for a PROJECT_OWNED asset

licence.description: e.g. CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0, public domain, written permission

description.description: what the photograph LITERALLY shows - not what it is used to teach

visually_verified.description: 'yes - <what was seen> <date>', or a plain statement that it was not verified. Never 'yes' for a file nobody opened.

caption_caveat.description: an honest near-miss note, e.g. 'a product tanker, not a gas carrier'
